title: 2.2 Trends in Global Climate Change
description: Observed warming, greenhouse gas records, IPCC assessments and temperature projections. Easy level.

questions.question: Where does the most convincing evidence of climate change come from?
options: Whether greenhouse gas emissions continue to rise
Observations of the atmosphere, land and oceans
Human activities have altered atmospheric composition
It was likely the warmest century in a millennium
questions.correctAnswer: Observations of the atmosphere, land and oceans

questions.question: Which records show rising greenhouse gas concentrations over recent centuries?
options: Warming has accelerated in recent decades
Carbon dioxide, methane and nitrous oxide
Observations of the atmosphere, land and oceans
Ice core records and in situ observations
questions.correctAnswer: Ice core records and in situ observations

questions.question: Which gases increased over the last few centuries?
options: Observations of the atmosphere, land and oceans
Warming has accelerated in recent decades
Ice core records and in situ observations
Carbon dioxide, methane and nitrous oxide
questions.correctAnswer: Carbon dioxide, methane and nitrous oxide

questions.question: What did the IPCC 2001 report say about the 1990s?
options: It was the warmest decade worldwide
Carbon dioxide, methane and nitrous oxide
Warming has accelerated in recent decades
Ice core records and in situ observations
questions.correctAnswer: It was the warmest decade worldwide
